decisions.reason: The IMU module fits the core modular platform and costs little to keep stocked, and its move to a page of its own in 2024 suggests growing commitment, so the option stays open.
The industrial AC input module has had its own page since launch and was featured in launch news, which signals that its value is being realized in industrial uses at low ongoing cost.
The solid state relay module is a cheap add-on within the established building-block system, and the evidence on its demand is not yet clear enough to justify abandoning it.
The RGB LED module launched only in 2024, so its prospects are still uncertain and keeping it in a modular catalog costs little, which argues for holding the option.
The remote wallbox access service supports the firm's strategic expansion into charging and energy management, and its value is still unresolved, so management keeps the option.
